surface: Validated literal DELETE routes, explicit repository selectors, direct secret/cache/SSH key requests, and ordered Boolean controls. Prompt-driven current repository deletion and glab unconfirmed deletion stay May; unresolved configuration never becomes a concrete host or repository. Request shape, execution assurance, and modality remain independent. gh release delete and delete-asset prompt only when stdin and stdout are terminals and fail when the prompt is declined, so a successful one deleted its target with or without --yes. gh issue delete asks only when it can prompt and fails when the answer does not match, so it is must-on-success too; gist, SSH key, GPG key and repository deletes refuse without a terminal unless confirmed and stay May.
